import json, urllib.request
url='http://127.0.0.1:18114/api/state'
with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as r:
    state=json.load(r)
ids=['BE-203','BE-207','BE-211']
cards=[c for c in state['cards'] if c['id'] in ids]
assert [c['id'] for c in cards] == ids
expected={
 'BE-203':('IN_REVIEW','Platform On-Call','P1','at_risk'),
 'BE-207':('RESOLVED','Data Ops','P2','within_sla'),
 'BE-211':('IN_PROGRESS','Runtime Team','P1','overdue'),
}
for c in cards:
    status,owner,priority,sla=expected[c['id']]
    assert (c['status'],c['owner'],c['priority'],c['sla'])==(status,owner,priority,sla),c
    assert c['resolution']
assert len(state['cards']) == 8
assert state['revision'] == 1
out={'queue':'backend','cards':cards}
with open('/home/user/workspace/status_board/out/backend_export.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print('API state verified; revision',state['revision'])
print(json.dumps(cards,indent=2))
print('export:',open('/home/user/workspace/status_board/out/backend_export.json').read())
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, urllib.request, pathlib
base='http://127.0.0.1:18114'
def get():
    with urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/api/state') as r: return json.load(r)
state=get()
updates={
 'FL-104': {'status':'IN_PROGRESS','owner':'Maya Chen','priority':'P1','sla':'at_risk','resolution':'Validation: checkout retries exceed normal limit; investigation underway.'},
 'FL-108': {'status':'RESOLVED','owner':'Jordan Lee','priority':'P2','sla':'within_sla','resolution':'Resolved: receipt email delay after payment; delivery validation recorded.'},
 'FL-112': {'status':'ESCALATED','owner':'Sam Rivera','priority':'P1','sla':'overdue','resolution':'Validation: regional tax rounding mismatch; escalated for review.'},
}
for card in state['cards']:
    if card['id'] in updates:
        card.update(updates[card['id']])
req=urllib.request.Request(base+'/api/save',data=json.dumps(state).encode(),headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Queue':'frontline'},method='POST')
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
    print('SAVE',r.status,r.read().decode())
verified=get()
front=[c for c in verified['cards'] if c['id'] in updates]
assert len(front)==3
for c in front:
    assert all(c[k]==v for k,v in updates[c['id']].items()), c
out=pathlib.Path.home()/'workspace/status_board/out/frontline_export.json'
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(front,indent=2)+'\n')
print('VERIFY',json.dumps(front,indent=2))
print('EXPORT',out, out.stat().st_size)
PY
